copy.title: The Trump Money File
copy.desc: An interactive, fully sourced map of Donald Trump’s family: who owns and runs what, which family companies trade on the stock market, and the money in his financial disclosures.
copy.eyebrow: File #026 · The Trump family · Data as of
copy.h1: The president has a family. We followed the money.
copy.lede: Who’s who, what each of them owns or runs, which family companies you can buy stock in, and the money in his federal financial disclosures. Every number links to its source.
copy.familyLede: Tap anyone to open their file: what they own, what’s on the record, and where every fact comes from. All five of Donald’s children are adults.
copy.investLede: Two family-linked companies trade on Nasdaq: Trump Media (DJT) and American Bitcoin (ABTC). The WLFI and $TRUMP tokens trade on crypto exchanges, but they aren’t shares in the companies behind them.
copy.moneyLede: Real estate built the family fortune. For 2025, Donald’s disclosure showed more income from crypto ventures ($1.4 billion) than from his properties and golf clubs ($389 million or more). Forbes publishes a net worth only for Donald.
copy.recordLede: What his federal financial disclosures, SEC filings and the companies’ own records show. Filings and reporting, not guesses.
copy.trailLede: From his father’s New York apartment buildings to crypto ventures in 2025.
copy.calcYearsK: Years to earn what Donald has

summary.t: Businesswoman born in Czechoslovakia. In the 1980s she was a Trump Organization executive: she ran the Trump Castle casino in Atlantic City and managed the Plaza Hotel in Manhattan. She died in 2022.

record.t: Her settlement included $14 million, a Connecticut mansion, an apartment in Trump Plaza and use of Mar-a-Lago one month a year, The New York Times reported in 1991.

facts.t: After the divorce she sold clothing, jewelry and beauty lines on HSN and QVC, and wrote the 2017 memoir Raising Trump.

summary.t: Became president of his father’s New York real estate company in 1971 and began calling it the Trump Organization. Hosted The Apprentice from 2004 to 2015. The 45th president (2017–2021), and the 47th since January 2025.

owns.t: His revocable trust holds 114,750,000 shares, about 41% of the company, per a September 2026 SEC filing. Forbes valued the stake at $1.2 billion in March 2026.
Owner of the family’s real estate, golf, club and licensing business, which two of his sons manage. His disclosure for 2025 reported more than $77 million from Mar-a-Lago.
Listed as co-founder emeritus. His disclosure for 2025 reported $526 million from World Liberty token sales, plus $65 million from equity sales in its holding company.

CIC Digital, a Trump Organization affiliate, and Fight Fight Fight LLC hold 80% of the $TRUMP meme coin supply, unlocking over three years. His disclosure for 2025 listed $636 million from CIC Digital.

record.t: Released by the Office of Government Ethics on June 30, 2026: more than $1.4 billion from crypto ventures, and at least $389 million from his properties, golf courses and clubs.
Made public in June 2025: over $600 million in income and $1.6 billion in assets, including $57.3 million from World Liberty token sales.
Bought in 1985 for an estimated $10 million and turned into a members’ club in 1995. Forbes valued it at about $560 million in March 2026.

facts.t: Forbes valued his World Liberty and $TRUMP tokens at nearly $570 million combined, and his golf properties at about $550 million (March 2026).
In December 2024 he moved all 114,750,000 of his Trump Media shares into a revocable trust. They were worth more than $4 billion at the time.

kidsNote.t: Donald has five children, all adults: Don Jr., Ivanka and Eric with Ivana; Tiffany with Marla Maples; and Barron with Melania.

summary.t: Former fashion model, born in Novo Mesto, Slovenia. Married Donald in January 2005. First lady from 2017 to 2021, and again since January 2025.

worth.none: No published estimate of her own.

record.t: Donald’s financial disclosure for 2025 lists more than $10 million for an Amazon documentary about her and more than $500,000 for her book Melania, AFP reported.

summary.t: Actress and TV personality who appeared on Broadway in The Will Rogers Follies in 1992. Married Donald in December 1993; they separated in 1997 and divorced in 1999.

facts.t: Their prenuptial agreement and divorce settlement bind her to confidentiality about the marriage.

summary.t: Built single-family houses in Queens and more than 27,000 apartments in New York. Made Donald president of the family company in 1971 and became its chairman.

record.t: His family estimated his estate at $250 million to $300 million when he died in 1999.

facts.t: His company, E. Trump & Son, was incorporated in 1927.

summary.t: Emigrated from Scotland to New York in 1930 and married Fred in 1936. A longtime volunteer at Jamaica Hospital in Queens, which named a nursing-home pavilion after her.
A trustee and executive vice president of the Trump Organization, which he runs with his brother Eric.

owns.t: A backer of the company, which his brother Eric co-founded.

record.h: Trustee of the Trump Media shares
record.t: Named sole trustee, with sole voting and investment power, of the revocable trust that received his father’s 114,750,000 Trump Media shares in December 2024.

facts.t: Became a partner at the investment firm 1789 Capital in November 2024, and joined the board of PublicSquare in December 2024.

summary.t: Former executive vice president of the Trump Organization. Closed her fashion company in July 2018. Unpaid adviser to her father in the White House, 2017–2021. Married to Jared Kushner since 2009.

record.t: She and Kushner reported income of $36.2 million to $157 million in 2019, including $3.9 million from her stake in the Trump hotel in Washington, D.C. Disclosures report most amounts in ranges.

summary.t: A trustee and executive vice president of the Trump Organization, which he runs with Don Jr. Co-founder and chief strategy officer of American Bitcoin.

owns.t: Co-founder and chief strategy officer. Bloomberg valued his stake at over $500 million on its first trading day, Sept. 3, 2025.
Listed as a co-founder. He announced the project in August 2024.

people.name: Tiffany Trump

summary.t: Graduated from the University of Pennsylvania in 2016 and Georgetown Law in 2020. Married businessman Michael Boulos at Mar-a-Lago in 2022.

people.note: No role in the family companies appears in the filings and reporting used for this file.

summary.t: The youngest of the five. Listed as a co-founder of World Liberty Financial.

facts.t: World Liberty has also described him as its “DeFi visionary.”

companies.name: Trump Media & Technology Group
companies.who: Donald (about 41%, held in his revocable trust)
companies.t: Runs Truth Social. Donald’s trust holds 114,750,000 of 277.9 million shares, per a September 2026 SEC filing. An all-stock merger with fusion company TAE Technologies is expected to close in late 2026; the company is to stay listed as DJT.

companies.name: American Bitcoin
companies.who: Eric (co-founder, chief strategy officer) · Don Jr. (backer)
companies.t: Bitcoin miner, majority-owned by Hut 8. It began trading on Nasdaq on Sept. 3, 2025, after merging with Gryphon Digital Mining. Bloomberg valued Eric’s stake at over $500 million that day.

companies.name: World Liberty Financial
companies.who: Donald (co-founder emeritus) · Eric, Don Jr. & Barron (co-founders)
companies.t: Crypto platform announced in August 2024, with its own stablecoin, USD1. Its WLFI token began trading in September 2025. AFP reports Trump and his three sons got 22.5 billion WLFI through DT Marks Defi, worth about $1.3 billion in July 2026.

companies.name: The Trump Organization
companies.t: Private real estate, golf, club and licensing company, including Mar-a-Lago. Donald’s properties, golf courses and clubs brought in at least $389 million in 2025, per his disclosure.

companies.name: CIC Digital ($TRUMP coin)
companies.t: With Fight Fight Fight LLC, holds 80% of the $TRUMP meme coin, launched on the Solana blockchain in January 2025. The coin trades on crypto exchanges; CIC Digital has no public shares. It brought Donald $636 million in 2025, mostly royalties.
